annotations.title: Spend firewall: allow, hold or block an agent payment before it happens

description:
Spend firewall for AI agents with a wallet or card, called before every payment: checks your rules (per-payment cap, daily budget reserved atomically, allow/block lists, chains, tokens, approval threshold, new merchants, kill switch), the merchant or checkout URL (preflight), the text that triggered the payment (input-guard: hidden instructions) and non-USDC tokens (token-risk). Returns allow, hold or block with reasons; with a stored policy the amount is reserved until confirm or release. Free with a key (500 calls) or 5 calls a day without one; then 0.02 USDC per call via x402, or 1 call from a key.
After: pay, then POST /shield/confirm with the reservation_id (or /shield/release if you did not pay) (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Your key instead of paying per call: free (500 calls, POST /key) or bought by card. The connection header X-Bundle-Token works too.

hold_seconds.description: how long an allowed amount stays reserved (default 900)

idempotency_key.description: same key = same reservation, never reserved twice

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from (optional; the x402 price is the same for every address).

merchant_url.description: shop, checkout or payment link, API or x402 endpoint the agent is about to pay

pay_to.description: recipient address, when there is no URL

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

policy.description: inline rules (stateless); for a daily budget and remembered merchants store them with POST /shield/policy and send policy_id

policy_id.description: a stored policy (needs your key as X-Bundle-Token or bundle_token)

trigger.description: the instruction, message or page that made the agent want to pay
